expectations.evidence: Identifies 4 layers as levers: (1) Relationship Type (Graph + Disposition), (2) Cooperation Strategy (Character Profile), (3) Dilemma Detection & Resolution, (4) Narrative Prose (Archetype Beat Patterns). Each connected to betrayal mechanics via disposition system.

expectations.text: references-exact-files: Response references exact file paths (src/data/*-content.ts) for modifications
expectations.evidence: References src/data/world-model.json, src/data/archetype-content.ts, src/data/narrative-content.ts, src/data/game-theory-content.ts, src/engine/disposition.ts, src/types/disposition.ts with specific line numbers and change descriptions.

expectations.text: produces-data-structures: Response includes concrete TypeScript data structures following existing patterns
expectations.evidence: Includes beat pattern structures for schemer archetype (eventTypes, minimumTier, promoteTo, narrativeRequirements, contextPreferences), enhanced dilemma_betrayed templates, and references game-theory-content.ts strategy weights with concrete values (always-defect: 0.45).

expectations.text: follows-checklist: Response addresses opposition hooks, beat pattern coverage, culture-awareness, voice mode
expectations.evidence: Provides step-by-step breakdown (Steps 1-6) covering relationship edges, dilemma orchestration, beat patterns, templates, and narrative requirements. Includes testing checklist and tuning knobs section.

expectations.text: no-prose-writing: Response focuses on designing data structures, not writing narrative prose directly
expectations.evidence: Includes prose examples in Step 5 and Section 6 like '{actor} had positioned every piece for years...' and '{target} had called {actor} counselor and friend...' These are actual narrative prose, not structural data definitions.

expectations.text: integration-awareness: Response shows how content flows through the narrative pipeline
expectations.evidence: Explains how disposition system's game-theory logic triggers dilemma detection, which maps to narrative events, which are routed through prose pipeline. Shows beat pattern filtering and context object ranking by opposition scoring.
